## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and final behavior. Link the issue when applicable.

## Validation

List checks and results. Include redacted actual app screenshots for UI changes and real hardware evidence for CUDA, pairing or inference changes. Distinguish CI compilation from GPU acceptance.

## Compatibility and risk

Explain effects on existing pairing, SSH restrictions, ports, telemetry schema, GPU selection and packaging. Include migration or rollback steps.

- [ ] Tests and documentation match the final change.
- [ ] No credentials, pairing material, private network details, diagnostics or model data are included.
- [ ] Dependency and workflow permission changes are explained.
- [ ] Existing trusted identities and loopback boundaries are preserved.
